evals.name: official-style-preserves-repository-settings
evals.prompt: 공식 nightly Rust Style Guide 기준으로 이번 Rust 변경을 검수해줘. 저장소에는 stable 툴체인 고정과 rustfmt max_width = 120 설정이 있고 툴체인 변경은 범위 밖이야.
evals.expected_output: Consults the local style reference and repository toolchain and formatter settings. Checks formatting using the existing configuration and relevant manifest or workspace command. Does not switch to nightly, overwrite max_width with the guide's default, change the edition, or reformat unrelated files. Separates formatting checks from API naming and behavior review.

evals.name: conversion-names-reflect-cost-and-ownership
evals.prompt: 아직 공개하지 않은 Rust API 이름을 검토해줘. as_text(&self) -> String은 문자열을 복사하고, as_str(&self) -> Option<&str>은 UTF-8을 검사하며 빌린 문자열을 돌려줘. to_bytes(self) -> Vec<u8>는 non-Copy 래퍼를 소비해서 내부 버퍼를 꺼내.
evals.expected_output: Uses C-CONV to recommend names reflecting the supplied cost and ownership, such as to_text, to_str, and into_bytes respectively. Recognizes that validation may justify to_ without allocation. Does not change signatures to fit names, invent copying where a buffer is transferred, or treat every borrowed result as an as_ conversion.

evals.name: getter-exceptions-and-public-compatibility
evals.prompt: 배포 중인 Rust 컬렉션 API를 명명 가이드로 리뷰해줘. get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&Item>과 iter(&self) -> Iter가 있어. 호환성을 깨는 변경은 요청하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: Accepts indexed get as a legitimate getter exception and checks the borrowing semantics and corresponding iterator type. Does not demand renaming get solely because ordinary field getters omit get_. Preserves the published API and checks compatibility before suggesting a rename. Uses the official naming reference without treating rustfmt success as naming verification.

evals.name: closed-status-open-exporters
evals.prompt: 프로젝트는 작업 상태를 대기와 완료로 정했고 완료 상태에는 결과 경로가 필요하다. 파일로 내보내는 기능은 다른 crate에서 새 구현을 추가할 수 있어야 한다. 새 상태를 놓친 처리기가 컴파일 때 드러나고, 내보내기 구현을 추가해도 기존 호출자가 계속 동작하도록 설계해줘.
evals.expected_output: Models statuses and their required payloads as a closed enum. Adding another status makes an existing exhaustive handler fail to compile. Uses a trait for independently supplied exporters. A separate crate can implement the trait and pass its exporter to the existing caller without editing the caller.
